title: midstudy lighting inferred from the photo (scenes/<name>/lighting.json, contract §4.8)
description: Written by `midstudy-calib fit` (and `run`) next to calib.json. Units: three.js 0.180 light units, linear sRGB, for ACES Filmic at exposure 1. Frame: the camera's (three.js axes: x right, y up, z towards the viewer); the planner rotates it with the scene's current camera. Keys not listed here are allowed for diagnostics; readers ignore them.

source.description: photo: inferred from the photo; truth: the golden scenes' own lights (fixtures/scenes only).

image.description: photo.jpg's size when the fit ran.

camera.description: The camera block the fit used (informational: the planner uses the scene's current camera).

sh.description: L2 spherical harmonics, three.js SphericalHarmonics3 order [L00, L1-1 (y), L10 (z), L11 (x), L2-2, L2-1, L20, L21, L22], radiance coefficients as THREE.LightProbe takes them, camera frame, RGB. The key light is not included.

direction.description: Unit vector towards the light, camera frame.

softness.description: 0 a hard sun edge, 1 very diffuse.

confidence.description: How clearly the photo shows one directional light.

rgb.description: The room light's overall colour, linear RGB with luminance 1.

radiance.description: Median linear radiance of the floor's pixels.
